role: Static facade over the current Locale: format(key, args...) translates a key through the loaded .lang files and applies String.format; setLocale is called by LanguageManager at startup.
notes: The native engine renders no translated text of its own: GUI strings (achievement toast title/description, item names if any) arrive in the render-state dump already resolved by the Java client, and raster_hud.c draws the recorded strings. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Translation of GUI strings; the native GUI draws the en_US strings it needs directly (for example raster_hud.c's container titles), so no translation layer runs natively.
